$comment: The service manifest. One row per Construct service Placard knows about — embedded into the placard binary, rendered on the front page, and the index /api/services serves. `raster_from_svg: true` means the mark PNGs are generated from <slug>/<slug>-mark.svg by `placard gen` (edit the SVG, never the PNGs). `color` is only present where BRAND.md establishes a rule — leave it absent rather than inventing one. Notes carry the 2026-08-15 launcher audit that prompted IDEA-22.

services.name: Lyceum
services.note: The only mark that rendered in the launcher pre-Placard. PNG seeded from the service repo, same image for both surfaces.

services.name: Argosy
services.note: The old jsDelivr path rotted when the asset was renamed in its own repo — the stored logo_url 404d and the launcher silently fell back to initials. The canonical copies live here now: the ship glyph alone (the full wordmark lockup stays in the argosy repo; text is illegible at tile size). Squared 2026-08-27: the glyph is 2.28:1 and the mark inherited that, so Cloudflare's square launcher tile cropped the outer ships off — visible in the launcher and not in Placard's own view, which fits rather than fills. The SVG viewBox now pads to 1:1 instead of cropping tight, so the glyph keeps its scale and gains transparent space above and below.

services.name: Switchyard
services.note: Repo is private — jsDelivr could not serve it at any path, ever. The mark's public home is here.

services.name: Chronicle
services.note: Mark 2a, the interrupted rule (CHRN-115): two ruled lines, a waveform across the middle, two more rules. Until this row Placard had no slug for Chronicle, Purser reported its Access application as `adopt` with a note, and the App Launcher showed two initials. Authored per variant: the dark plate carries a vellum glyph, the light plate an ink one, both full-bleed and square because the launcher tile fills rather than fits. The light mark is the one Purser resolves.
services.legacy_source: none — chronicle@main/web/src/components/Mark.vue draws the same glyph at 22px; Chronicle.dc.html pass 02 is the design

services.name: Wiki
services.note: No logo_url set on the Access application; renders as two grey initials.

services.name: App Launcher
services.note: No logo_url set. Acceptable — it is the surface, not a service.

services.name: Amber
services.note: No mark yet. Gold #d99b2b is reserved as Amber's reference colour — see BRAND.md.

services.name: Placard
services.note: This service: the front page you are reading, and the mirror of every mark in this repo.
